description: Copy the behavioural settings (features, rooms policy, matchmaking, inbox, p2p, serverMode, permissions, theme, connections, ai…) from one of your apps (what it is being edited to: its pre with its draft) into another's draft; the users get them with neblla_promote "publish". Name, files, domains, slug, gallery and billing are never copied. Overwrites those settings on the target. An app from before the modules (features with the old switches: multiplayer, login…) gives the modules they mean. Returns `copied` (the fields copied) and `skipped` ([{ field, error, message }]: what the target refused, e.g. a setting in an old shape; set it by hand with neblla_update_app).

fromAppId.description: Source app (settings are read from it)

name: neblla_copy_app_config
title: Copy app config
